messages:
nina: Heads-up I'm opening a tiny docs PR for private/VPC on-prem migration: adds a short cert-rotation note, an offline repo mirror example, and a helper script to validate PKCS#11 libs. github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1402 :wave:
hao: thanks. Can you paste the helper script here so we can eyeball it quickly?
devon: also add a 1-liner for rotating KMS certs with minimal downtime (preferably using a sidecar reload). We've seen customers rekey and accidentally break HA.
nina: pasted the helper script (very small):
```bash
#!/bin/sh
# scan common pkcs11 paths and list modules
paths="/usr/lib/*/pkcs11* /usr/local/lib/*pkcs11* /opt/*/lib/*pkcs11*"
for p in $paths; do
  for f in $p; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    echo "found: $f"
    pkcs11-tool --module "$f" -L 2>/dev/null || echo "(no token or missing tool)"
  done
done
```
hao: perfect. For the cert rotation note, suggest recommending a two-step rollout: deploy new cert (non-active), update KMS to present new cert behind a loadbalancer, then switch active backend. Minimizes outage.
devon: add a quick haproxy reload snippet: `echo "set ssl cert /etc/haproxy/certs/kms.pem" | socat stdio /run/haproxy/admin.sock` so customers can swap certs without full restart.
nina: added both. For airgap: included a short mirror example using `reposync -p /tmp/mirror -r base -a x86_64 && rsync -av /tmp/mirror/ user@airgap:/opt/mirror/` and a sha256 check step.
infra-bot: CI: docs lint OK for PR 1402.
hao: minor wording nit: don't use "expose certs" anywhere. Replace with "present a cert chain signed by customer's root CA; private key must remain on HSM or KMS host with restricted access."
nina: fixed wording. Also added a tiny openssl troubleshooting command: `openssl s_client -connect kms.local:8443 -servername kms.local -showcerts` and a note about setting `-servername` for SNI.
devon: LGTM. Please also add a one-line troubleshooting for SELinux file contexts (we had one customer with /etc/hsm files blocked). Suggest `restorecon -Rv /etc/hsm` example.
nina: added it. Marked PR as docs:review and requested @hao and @devon.
docs-bot: PR 1402: label set to docs-review. 2 reviewers requested: @hao, @devon.
nina: thanks all. If reviewers approve I'll merge after CI and backport a 1-line note into the migration checklist.
